component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.records.listener
component.documentation: The disposition review, reached the way the platform's retention module reaches its records: through the repository's own document events, with no Automation operation and no endpoint of its own. A person files a DispositionRequest in the DispositionRuns folder, to start a run or to approve or reject one; this listener, synchronous, checks it with the person's permissions and does the work, in a transaction of its own inside the add-on's lock, or refuses it, and then nothing is written. An audit export filed there is checked the same way, and, once created, made readable by its filer alone. It refuses, too, every other change to the add-on's documents but its own.
